messages:
olivia: Proposal: lightweight 'Trial Reserve' onboarding to reserved pools. Let smaller customers get soft reserved behavior (quota + limited burst) without long contracts. Need GA criteria and scope.

sam: Is this routing only or billing too?

olivia: Routing + quota policy + Console flow. Billing conversion handled manually for pilots.

priya: Ops flag: avoid noisy neighbors. We need SLOs, prewarm rules, and an occupancy fallback.

jordan: Sales: good for closing mid-market. Want a 3-month trial option with clear terms.

mike: CS: four asks last quarter for "try reserved" — customers care about p95 latency.

anya: Design: two tracks — Trial Reserve (90d, capped, lower SLA) and Commit Reserve (paid SLA). Trial auto-expires.

sam: Eng approach: per-tenant token-bucket + admission priority. Exceed cap -> fallback to hosted or throttle.

priya: Ops policy proposal: cap sustained concurrency, mark trial tenants low priority, preempt after 5m sustained usage.

olivia: GA acceptance checklist:
- Console/API onboarding for trial tenants
- Quota enforcement + auto-expire after 90d
- Observability: trial labels in usage export and latency dashboard
- Safety: fallback routing when shared occupancy >80%
- No regression on existing dedicated customers (p95 within +5ms)

jordan: Timeline: sales needs pilots next month. GA target ~8 weeks.

sam: Eng estimate: 3w quota/admission, 2w routing+fallback, 1w console/tests, +1w rollout = ~7w. Add 1w for chaos/safe rollback -> 8w.

olivia: Quota defaults decision?

sam: Propose 50k tokens/day default, burst 2x for 5m windows.

priya: Conservative: 50k tokens/day, burst 1.5x. Ops will tune during pilots.

jordan: Sales wants optional 100k/day manual enable for strategic pilots.

olivia: Agreed defaults: 50k/day, burst 1.5x (5m); pilot overrides to 100k.

priya: Ops alerts to add: trial preempts >2x/day, shared occupancy >85% for 10m, conversion rate <5% for pilot cohort.

anya: I'll draft console copy and email template: "Trial Reserve: 90 days, 50k tokens/day by default, bursts up to 1.5x for 5m".

jordan: Sales will list pilot customers by EOD.

mike: CS will prep onboarding checklist and weekly sync doc.

olivia: Next steps: sam+priya break into tickets, anya draft UX copy, jordan+mike pick pilots. If no objections, mark GA criteria approved and schedule in sprint. React :thumbsup: to approve.
